structured_stats.description:
The '''Golden Cowboy''' is a golden perk for the [[Cowboy]], unlocked from the [[Golden Crate]] for {{Coins|50,000}}, if you have the [[Cowboy]]. It can also appear in the daily skin store for {{Coins|70,000}}.

While initially it has a slow firerate, it deals moderate damage with a fairly low range. On later levels, the '''Golden Cowboy''' gains much higher damage, higher range and a faster firerate. The '''Golden Cowboy''' can also generate cash every sixth shot. The amount of shots needed for the '''Golden Cowboy''' to generate cash can be seen above its tower icon in the upgrade box or when you hover your cursor over it. After firing the last shot, it will spin its gun for a short while. The ''Spin Time'' is decreased at higher Levels. This ability can act as a primary or secondary source of economy. 

The '''Golden Cowboy''' is considered an all round tower. Its DPS makes it decent to defend early and mid-game, while its ability to generate cash can make it useful for the entire match.

In comparison to its normal counterpart, the [[Cowboy]], the '''Golden Cowboy''' has higher damage, slightly higher range at Level 0 and it generates more money. It is, however, more expensive to place down and upgrade.

The '''Golden Cowboy''' has a placement limit of twelve per player.

==Description==
The '''Cowboy Plush''' is an upcoming official Paradoxum Games toy which is currently available to be pre-ordered. It was made by Juniper Creates. The plushie offers the Level 4 [[Cowboy]]. Anybody who bought the toy from the in-game Merch Store will receive the {{Color|Other|Umbra}} skin for the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} skin for the [[Cowboy]]. If bought on the [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games store], it will not come with any rewards.

The revolvers of the '''Cowboy Plush''' are detachable. It is made out of plush fabric and polypropylene cotton, its size measures 13 inches (33.02 cm) tall, 10.6 inches (26.924 cm) wide and 11.8 inches (29.972 cm) long. A tree is planted for every order of the plush.

==Official Description==
*'''Online (Third)'''
*:Howdy partner, the fan favorite Cowboy tower is here as a plush and he is packing some heat with his removable revolvers. This plush does not include an in-game reward. 
*'''Online (Second)'''
*:Howdy partner, the fan favorite Cowboy tower is here as a plush and he is packing some heat with his removable revolvers. The in-game reward is only included with purchases made in Roblox. Items purchased from shop.paradoxum.games do not include an in-game reward.
*'''Online (First)'''
*:Howdy partner, the fan favorite Cowboy tower is here as a plush and he's packing some heat with his removable revolvers.

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Cowboy Plush''' can be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $34.99. If bought as part of the Cowboy Bundle, which also includes the [[Cowboy]] pin, it costs $43.18.

Before April 2025, the '''Cowboy Plush''' could be purchased for $29.99, while the bundle could be purchased for $35.98. During the Black Friday 2024 Sale, it could be bought for $22.49, while the bundle had a cost of $26.98. During the Black Friday 2025 Sale, it had a cost of $28.99, while the bundle could be bought for $36.78.

==Description==
The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' was a [[Units|unit]] spawned by the [[Golden Crook Boss]] at Level 3. In the game, the '''Golden Body Guards 1''' was referred to as just '''Body Guards''', though it has been referenced here as '''Golden Body Guards 1''' to differentiate itself from other [[Crook Boss]] and [[Golden Crook Boss]] units. As with other [[units]], it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map.

Whenever there was an enemy in its range, the '''Golden Body Guards 1''' would stop moving to shoot at the enemies. It would continue walking when there were no enemies left in its range. The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' had a spawnrate of 40 seconds.

There was a limit of two units per [[Golden Crook Boss]] at Level 3, limiting the amount of '''Golden Body Guards 1s''' it could spawn.

==Appearance==
The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' were made up of two humanoids that were nearly identical to each other. They had pale skin, black pants, brown cotton gloves, a black buttoned tuxedo with a golden shirt underneath and grey shoes. One of them also wore a blue necktie, while the other a red necktie, and were faceless. One of them also had a yellow briefcase on its back. The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' wield a [[wp:Luger pistol|Luger P08]] in their right hands.

==Strategy==
*You should not rely too much on the '''Golden Body Guards 1''' because of its slow spawnrate.
*You will need to wait 40 seconds for a '''Golden Body Guards 1''' to spawn if you place down a [[Crook Boss]] and immediately upgrade it to Level 3.
*The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with [[defense]], like the [[Giant Boss]].
**However, the '''Golden Body Guards 1's''' ranged damage is still affected by enemies with [[defense]].
*The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' cannot detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Flying]] enemies, but they can still be damaged when the '''Golden Body Guards 1''' collides with them. However, this is likely unfavorable as the '''Golden Body Guards 1's''' damage comes primarily from firing at enemies rather than collision.
**The [[Ace Pilot]] cannot give the '''Golden Body Guards 1''' hidden detection.
**The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' cannot collide with ghost enemies, like the [[Soul]].
*On maps with multiple paths, only one '''Golden Body Guards 1''' will spawn per Level 3 [[Golden Crook Boss]].
**The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' will go down a random path.
*The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' will struggle against fast enemies, like the [[Shock]] or [[Glitch]], as they can run into the '''GoldenBody Guard 2''' without taking much damage.
*The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' is not affected by any buff or debuff.
*The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units, because of its low health.
**For example, if the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] uses its ''Stomp'' attack, and a '''Golden Body Guards 1''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly killed.

==Description==
The '''Golden Crate''' is a crate that grants one of seven {{Color|Golden}} skins which come with a Golden Perk. It costs a colossal {{Coins|50,000}}, the single most expensive crate and item you can buy in the game with coins. Golden Perks make towers much stronger, but usually more expensive as well.

Each skin in this crate can appear in the daily skin store. Uniquely, unlike all other crates, each skin in this crate has its own cost. The {{Color|Golden}} [[Soldier]] skin costs {{Coins|50,000}}, the {{Color|Golden}} [[Scout]], {{Color|Golden}} [[Demoman]] and {{Color|Golden}} [[Crook Boss]] skins cost {{Coins|55,000}}, the {{Color|Golden}} [[Pyromancer]] costs {{Coins|65,000}}, the {{Color|Golden}} [[Cowboy]] costs {{Coins|70,000}} and the {{Color|Golden}} [[Minigunner]] costs {{Coins|75,000}}

The top of the crate opens up in a futuristic fashion, with the left and right side respectively sliding to the left and right, revealing a pile of coins inside.
|Second
|The crate was larger than the [[Basic Crate]]. It was more smooth and sleek, and appeared to open up like a futuristic crate. There was a card reader attached to it.

==Description==
The '''Golden Crook''' was a [[Units|unit]] spawned by the [[Crook Boss|{{Color|Golden}} Crook Boss]] at Levels 2-3. The '''Golden Crook''' was essentially a re-skin of the [[Crook]], as it had similar appearance and stats, but had very little in common with the [[Body Guard]] and [[Body Guards 1]]. Like other [[units]], it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map. The '''Golden Crook''' had a spawnrate of 60 seconds.

Whenever there was an enemy in its range, the '''Golden Crook''' would stop moving to shoot at the enemy. It would continue walking when there were no enemies left in its range.

There was a limit of 3 units per [[Crook Boss|{{Color|Golden}} Crook Boss]], limiting the amount of '''Golden Crooks''' it could spawn.

==Appearance==
{{Tabber
|Version 2
|The '''Golden Crook''' had tan skin, black pants, dark grey shoes, yellow torso with black and yellow stripes, and yellow sleeves. It had a smile face. It wore a yellow beanie. It carried a golden [[wp:Uzi|UZI]] in its right hand to shoot at enemies. Yellow sparkles came out from its UZI.
|Version 1
|The original '''Golden Crook''' had yellow skin, black legs, yellow torso with black and yellow stripes, yellow sleeves, and a mischievous face. It wore a yellow and black striped headband. Yellow sparkles came out from its headband and a golden aura came out of its torso. It carried a golden [[wp:Uzi|UZI]] to shoot at enemies.
}}

*You should not rely too much on '''Golden Crooks''' because of their slow spawnrate.
*The '''Golden Crook''' cannot detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Flying]] enemies, but they can still be damaged when the '''Golden Crook''' collides with them. However, this is likely unfavorable as the '''Crook's''' main source of damage is ranged.
**The [[Ace Pilot]] cannot give the '''Golden Crook''' hidden detection.
*On two-pathed maps, only one '''Golden Crook''' will spawn per Level 2 [[Crook Boss|{{Color|Golden}} Crook Boss]]. It will go down a random path.
*The '''Golden Crook''' cannot collide with ghost enemies, like the [[Soul]].
*The '''Golden Crook''' will struggle against fast enemies like the [[Error]] or [[Glitch]], as they can run into '''Golden Crooks''' without taking much damage.
*The range of the '''Golden Crook''' can be increased by the [[DJ Booth]], as long as the [[Crook Boss|{{Color|Golden}} Crook Boss]] that spawned it is in range of the [[DJ Booth]].
**The '''Golden Crook''' cannot be affected by any other buffs or debuffs, such as [[Commander]]'s [[Firerate Buff]] or [[Ace Pilot]]'s ability to grant hidden detection.
*The '''Golden Crook''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units, as their health is lower than any amount of damage that these enemies deal.
**For example, if the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] uses its ''Stomp'' attack, and a '''Golden Crook''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly killed.

It can also be bought in the Daily Store for {{Coins|55,000}}. The normal counterpart, the [[Crook Boss]], can be claimed by reaching {{Level|30}} or alternatively purchasing it for {{Robux|300}}. Initially, the '''Golden Crook Boss''' has high damage, though it has rather low range. However, with later upgrades, the firerate decreases and its damage increases significantly. The range also increases and becomes comparable to towers like the [[Minigunner]]. The '''Golden Crook Boss''' has the ability to spawn [[Golden Pistol Goon]] from Level 0, which with later levels get double spawns. Additional, at Level 3, it spawns [[Golden Tommy Goon 1]], which gets replaced by [[Golden Tommy Goon 2]] at Level 4. Every time it summons an unit, it stops attacking for a second. All the units have flying detection but only the Tommy Goons have hidden detection. In comparison to its normal counterpart, the [[Crook Boss]], the '''Golden Crook Boss''' has higher damage and slightly higher range, but it is more expensive at all Levels. It also spawns stronger units. The '''Golden Crook Boss''' can be considered a mid to late-game tower, as its expensive cost for extremely high DPS makes it a great tower later on during the game and has sufficient DPS to remain strong in the extra-late game. There is a limit of five '''Golden Crook Bosses''' per player.
